title: Mistake: localStorage returns null
why_it_matters: JSON.parse(null) can crash a fresh visitor's first load.
explanation: A key that was never saved returns null, and everything is stored as a string. Provide a fallback before parsing. Wrap in try and catch too, because storage can be blocked or the saved text could be corrupted.
try_it: Run it after localStorage.clear() and make sure nothing crashes.
